capabilities: Export selected notes to PDF, DOCX, or LaTeX source
Select notes via an index note's wikilinks or manual drag-and-drop ordering
Map heading levels to book structure (part, chapter, section) or inline styling
Generate a cover page and auto table of contents with configurable depth
Normalize Obsidian syntax (wikilinks, callouts, embeds, tags) to standard markdown
extras: Docs include a limitations section (mobile untested, PDF limited to 14 standard fonts, Mermaid placeholders in DOCX/LaTeX) and troubleshooting; no Obsidian marketplace review mentioned, install is manual from releases or source.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assemble multiple notes into a single formatted document (book or report) that can be shared or printed as PDF, Word, or LaTeX.
summary: Vault-to-book exporter that combines selected notes into a PDF, DOCX, or LaTeX document with cover page, table of contents, and configurable structure.
